children: said on Friday that Warren Buffett, its former CEO and the world's most famous investor, has been named chairman emeritus, effective immediately.
The company named Howard Buffett, a Berkshire director since 1993, as chairman.
"As Chairman Emeritus, Mr. Buffett will remain a member of the Board of Directors and will continue to offer his valued judgment and perspective," Berkshire said in a statement.
